name: Plot gate
description: The single gate in a burgher plot wall, opening the rear yard onto a street or close.

visual.look: Riven-plank leaf, ledged and braced, hung on two oak posts with strap hinges and a wooden latch; wattle yards use a woven hurdle leaf tied with withies, stone walls set the leaf between limestone rubble piers.
